purpose: Freeze revision-aware source knowability, lineage, missingness, PIT universe, and one broker-structure feature before any HENGCE broker candidate forward-return panel is opened.

broker_source_contract.source_client: official finmind-mcp / authorized GitHub Actions secret

official_update_semantics.dataset_update_time: Monday-Friday 18:30 Asia/Taipei; actual availability follows API
official_update_semantics.conservative_knowability: Broker event-date D data may be used no earlier than the next TWSE market open after D.

EVENT_DAY_FACT_RECONSTRUCTION.definition: Historical event-date broker facts retrieved after the event and potentially incorporating later official/vendor corrections or backfills.

VENDOR_AS_KNOWN_THEN_SNAPSHOT.definition: A source object frozen contemporaneously with retrieval timestamp and immutable content hashes, before later source revisions.

FORWARD_COLLECTED_VENDOR_SNAPSHOT.definition: A future broker object collected prospectively after this contract with event date, retrieval timestamp, physical SHA256 and logical-content digest preserved.
FORWARD_COLLECTED_VENDOR_SNAPSHOT.earliest_usable_time: next TWSE open after event date D, subject to successful retrieval and all lineage checks

examples.scope: Historical TaiwanStockTradingDailyReport rows were corrected and SecIdAgg regenerated for affected historical dates.
2022-10 through 2022-11 OTC broker data were backfilled/corrected and SecIdAgg updated.

known_revision_evidence.consequence: Current historical downloads are not treated as exact vendor snapshots as known on the event date.

pit_universe_and_timing.selection_universe: Reuse the frozen point-in-time U100 from the Selection Challenge contract without modification.

missingness_and_integrity.rule_nontrading: If canonical mother says Volume=0 and Turnover=0 on d, absence of broker rows is structural non-trading; do not impute a feature and do not label source missing.
missingness_and_integrity.rule_traded_but_no_broker_rows: If canonical mother indicates trading on d but no valid broker rows exist, broker feature is MISSING_SOURCE_DATA and the stock-date fails closed.
missingness_and_integrity.duplicate_key: (date, stock_id, securities_trader_id) duplicates fail closed unless the source itself supplies a documented canonical aggregate key; no silent summation of unexpected duplicates.
missingness_and_integrity.invalid_volume: Negative, nonnumeric or nonfinite buy_volume/sell_volume fails the stock-date.
missingness_and_integrity.coverage_claim: Boundary-date feasibility does not prove every 2021-2026 date is complete; coverage must be audited for every executed research date.

primary_feature_contract.broker_set: ALL observed valid securities_trader_id values for stock i on event date d; no named-broker whitelist/blacklist and no success-selected broker set.
primary_feature_contract.denominator: GROSS_TOTAL(i,d) = sum_b GROSS_b(i,d) over branches with GROSS_b > 0
primary_feature_contract.buy_price_sell_price_usage: Preserve for source lineage/audit only; do not price-weight the primary feature.
primary_feature_contract.sign_convention: Higher raw value means more concentrated gross broker participation. No bullish/bearish sign is hypothesized; primary inference is two-sided.

basis: Source timing and revision class are explicit.
Historical current archive is demoted to EVENT_DAY_FACT_RECONSTRUCTION.
Date-specific PIT universe and fail-closed missingness are fixed.
One broker feature, one-day lookback, all-branch broker set and direction convention are frozen before HENGCE broker outcomes.
contract_gate.authority_consequence: PREREGISTRATION_MAY_BE_FROZEN; FORWARD RETURNS REMAIN SEALED UNTIL PREREGISTRATION IS ALSO FROZEN_PASS.
